title: DNA OS ↔ Google Workspace Connection Family
scope: One Google Workspace connection family covering Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Sheets under a single OAuth identity/credential_ref. Reuses existing service://google/* bindings. No new MCP tools. V1 is read-only.

security.rule: Secret values are never recorded. Only credential_ref, account identity, granted scope summary, and connection status are recorded.

references.name: credential://google/workspace/oauth
references.purpose: Single Google Workspace OAuth family pointer (Keychain); shared by Gmail/Calendar/Drive/Sheets
references.resolution: macOS Keychain via DNA OS secret authority — never stored in source

references.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.calendarlist.readonly
references.purpose: Calendar list V1 least-privilege read scope

references.name: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/calendar.events.readonly
references.purpose: Calendar events V1 least-privilege read scope

connection_family.account_identity_resolution: Resolved only after Owner OAuth; never invented

sibling_existing.note: Already declared in remote-service-binding; remains in family but not a V1 live verification target

overall_gaps: No ACTIVE credential://google/workspace/oauth row in DNA OS registry yet — Owner OAuth admission required before BOUND
OAuth source path exists (connections/google-workspace/oauth) but CLIENT_CONFIGURATION_STATE=CONFIGURATION_REQUIRED until Owner admits client_id/client_secret/redirect URI
Gmail live path today may still resolve via existing email-alert-source → Edge Function; Workspace family wiring does not invent a second Gmail identity
Official Google Workspace MCP, if used, must remain DNA OS–owned (no client-direct registration)
Deadboard GMAIL_CLIENT_* must not be reused for this family
next_required_connection: GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_OAUTH_CLIENT_OWNER_ADMISSION_V1 — Owner supplies client_id, client_secret, exact redirect URI; then Owner login

projections.human_view: Connection Center parent: Google Workspace; children: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets

future_document_rule: Do not create a second Google login family or duplicate credential identity per service. Missing scope ⇒ that service AUTH_REQUIRED only; parent may be PARTIALLY_AUTHORIZED.
